items.title: Does Citigroup (C) Risk Error And USDC Pilot Change The Investment Case?
items.summary: Citigroup (NYSE:C) identified a US$35b risk modeling error in its European trading unit’s risk weighted asset calculations in 2026. The bank reported that the discrepancy was found through internal reviews and said it moved to adjust its models and capital metrics. Citigroup and partners ran a pilot using USDC stablecoins for cross border World Bank development disbursements to test on chain settlement. Focusing only on the US$35b risk modeling error and USDC pilot misses how these shifts...

items.title: 4 Wall Street Giants That Raised Their Dividends for Income Investors

items.title: Rare Citi signal seen just 3 times since 2000 is days from triggering
items.summary: Investing.com - Citi’s quantitative strategy team warns that its major bearish indicator is on course to trigger in the coming days, a signal that has fired only three times since 2000, each time preceding major drawdowns in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100.
